sources.title: Policy-Guided World Model Planning for Language-Conditioned Visual ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Navigating to a visually specified goal given natural language instructions remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI. Existing approaches either rely on reactive policies that struggle with long-horizon planning, or employ world models that suffer from poor action initialization in high-dimensional spaces.
